sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》（Hidden Brain）。
我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆（Shankar Vedantam）。

sentences.en: Barely a week after assuming office, President Donald Trump set off a worldwide firestorm
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统在上任仅一周后，就在全球范围内引发了一场轩然大波，

sentences.en: when he decided to temporarily ban migrants from seven Muslim-majority countries
sentences.zh: 因为他决定暂时禁止七个穆斯林占多数国家的移民，

sentences.en: and refugees from all over the world from entering the United States.
sentences.zh: 以及来自世界各地的难民进入美国。

sentences.en: I'm establishing new vetting measures to keep radical Islamic terrorists
sentences.zh: 我正在建立新的审查措施，以防止激进的伊斯兰恐怖分子

sentences.en: out of the United States of America.

sentences.zh: 我们不希望他们来到这里。

sentences.en: We only want to admit those into our country who will support our country
sentences.zh: 我们只想接纳那些支持我们国家

sentences.en: Trump's executive order was greeted with support in some quarters.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的行政命令在某些方面受到了支持。

sentences.en: President Trump came in here not just as a commander-in-chief for the military.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统来到这里，不仅仅是作为军队的总司令。

sentences.en: He's a CEO, and he's trying to run.
sentences.zh: 他是一位首席执行官，他正试图经营这个国家。

sentences.en: He's trying to protect everybody in the country.
sentences.zh: 他正试图保护国内的每一个人。

sentences.en: And he's trying to keep everybody, all Americans, regardless of religion,
sentences.zh: 他正试图保护所有人，所有的美国人，无论宗教信仰如何，

sentences.en: safe from the potential terrorists that come in.
sentences.zh: 免受可能潜入的恐怖分子的伤害。

sentences.en: I mean, some people from some of these parts of the world, believe it or not, want to kill us.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，信不信由你，来自世界上某些地区的一些人，确实想要杀死我们。

sentences.en: And with dismay and outrage in others.
sentences.zh: 而在其他方面，则充满了沮丧和愤怒。

sentences.en: Spontaneous protests erupted at airports and public squares across the nation.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的机场和公共广场爆发了自发的抗议活动。

sentences.en: You've got an obligation in it!
One technique we often use to understand current events is to look to the past,
sentences.zh: 我们理解时事时经常使用的一种技巧是回顾过去，

sentences.en: to see what history can teach us.
sentences.zh: 看看历史能教给我们什么。

sentences.en: But this is a process that is fraught with psychological peril.
sentences.zh: 但这却是一个充满心理风险的过程。

sentences.en: We're often inclined to draw lessons from history
sentences.zh: 我们往往倾向于从历史中汲取教训，

sentences.en: that suit our preconceived notions of how to think about the present.
sentences.zh: 以迎合我们对如何看待当下的先入之见。

sentences.en: Historians say there are important lessons that we can draw from the past,
sentences.zh: 历史学家说，我们可以从过去汲取重要的教训，

sentences.en: but there are also dangers to overly neat analogies.
sentences.zh: 但过于简单的类比也存在危险。

sentences.en: One analogy that many people have reached for in recent days
sentences.zh: 最近几天许多人试图使用的一个类比，

sentences.en: is the story of the SS St. Louis.
sentences.zh: 就是“圣路易斯号”（SS St. Louis）的故事。

sentences.en: It's a notable story, drawn from the Holocaust,
sentences.zh: 这是一个源自大屠杀的著名故事，

sentences.en: that is revealing in how we respond to the pleas of people
sentences.zh: 它揭示了我们如何回应那些

sentences.en: fleeing distant shores for the United States.
sentences.zh: 逃离遥远海岸前往美国的人们的恳求。

sentences.en: Many people might be familiar with the story of the St. Louis.
sentences.zh: 许多人可能对“圣路易斯号”的故事很熟悉。

sentences.en: On today's Hidden Brain, we're going to revisit that story
sentences.zh: 在今天的《隐藏的大脑》节目中，我们将重温那个故事，

sentences.en: and explore how it speaks to the current mood and anxieties of the United States.
sentences.zh: 并探讨它如何反映了美国当前的情绪和焦虑。

sentences.en: Deborah Lipstadt is a professor of religion at Emory University.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉·利普斯塔特（Deborah Lipstadt）是埃默里大学的宗教教授。

sentences.en: She's a historian who studied the Holocaust
sentences.zh: 她是一位研究大屠杀的历史学家，

sentences.en: and how the United States and other countries
dealt with the plight of Jewish refugees
fleeing Nazi Germany in the 1930s and 40s.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪30年代和40年代逃离纳粹德国的犹太难民的困境。

sentences.en: When a photograph recently circled the globe
sentences.zh: 当最近一张照片传遍全球，

sentences.en: showing a three-year-old child lying face down on a beach in Turkey,
sentences.zh: 显示一个三岁的孩子面朝下躺在土耳其的海滩上时，

sentences.en: the boy and his family had drowned
sentences.zh: 那个男孩和他的家人在试图逃离叙利亚冲突时溺水身亡，

sentences.en: as they tried to escape the conflict in Syria,
sentences.zh: 黛博拉·利普斯塔特写道，
看到这个孩子毫无生气的尸体被冲上海滩，

sentences.en: seeing the child's lifeless body washed up on a beach,
who among us does not wonder,

sentences.zh: 黛博拉·利普斯塔特，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: Deborah Lipstadt, welcome to Hidden Brain.
